_comment: Source of truth for Wren's App Analytics campaign tokens. Never type a token
by hand: run `python store/campaign_links.py` and copy what it prints.
'IG-Organic-Gone-By-Thursday' become two rows that will never be merged, and
one typo silently mints a third. That is the whole reason this file exists.
providerToken is NOT invented. Apple generates it when the first campaign
link is created in App Store Connect (Analytics > Acquisition > Campaigns >
+), and it is the same value for every campaign afterwards. Until it is
filled in here the generator refuses to print links, because a link missing
pt= is accepted by the App Store and attributed to nothing.
One token per CREATIVE, not per post. A token per post fragments the volume

campaigns.notes: Reels and stories. One token for the creative across every post of it.
Same creative, different channel, so a separate token.

campaigns.creative: The App Store badge and text link on the Apps page
campaigns.notes: Separate from site-wren-hero. Somebody who reached the Apps page went looking; somebody who clicked the hero was offered. Those are different intents and worth telling apart.
If AlternativeTo links to the App Store anywhere on the listing, use this attributed link.
One token for Reddit organic across all subreddits, not per post.

One token for all TikTok paid campaigns, not per ad group. Paid and organic TikTok are separated because the question each answers is different: tt-organic-* asks whether the creative earns attention, this asks what attention costs.

campaigns.creative: Meta Ads app install campaign (Instagram Reels, Stories, Feed)
campaigns.notes: One token for all Meta paid campaigns, not per ad set. Kept apart from ig-organic-* for the same reason as TikTok.

One token for everything Zeely runs, kept apart from meta-paid-* and tt-paid-* so Zeely's results can be judged on their own. If Zeely places Meta app-install ads, Meta substitutes the registered store URL and this token is dropped (verified for Meta 2026-10-02), so check where Zeely actually sends clicks.

campaigns.creative: Spencer on a plane holding Wren (first organic TikTok post, @software_spencerfields)
campaigns.notes: Its own token because it is its own creative: tt-organic-gone-by-thursday is a different piece, and one token per creative is the rule. Google Play equivalent uses the same name as utm_campaign.
